name: czrecoil_frame_start_mode_menu_handlers
description: CZRecoilFrame start-mode menu handlers dispatch multiplayer and campaign mode ids through RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers this menu-wrapper cluster yet; the handlers currently have functional evidence only.
The native smoke patches only the smoke process: RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker is redirected with a temporary code jump and restored before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x431270 validates LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker(&g_RecoilApp, 1, nullptr, 1, self->m_useArchiveBanks); adjacent campaign handlers follow the same wrapper pattern with mission ids 2 through 6.

The native smoke verifies multiplayer id 1 and campaign ids 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6, each with null zbd path, skipIntroFmvMode 1, and the handler's current m_useArchiveBanks value forwarded as missionFlags.
